verses.original: דִּ֭בְרֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ לְמוּאֵ֣ל מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ אִמּֽוֹ׃ יִסְּרַ֥תּוּ
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê me·leḵ lə·mū·’êl maś·śā ’ăšer- ’im·mōw yis·sə·rat·tū
verses.literal: [These are] the words of King Lemuel the burden that his mother taught him

verses.original: מַה־ בְּ֭רִי וּמַֽה־ בַּר־ בִּטְנִ֑י וּ֝מֶה בַּר־ נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mah- bə·rî ū·mah- bar- biṭ·nî ū·meh bar- nə·ḏā·rāy
verses.literal: What [shall I say] O my son What O son of my womb What O son of my vows

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתֵּ֣ן חֵילֶ֑ךָ לַנָּשִׁ֣ים וּ֝דְרָכֶ֗יךָ לַֽמְח֥וֹת מְלָכִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tit·tên ḥê·le·ḵā lan·nā·šîm ū·ḏə·rā·ḵe·ḵā lam·ḥō·wṯ mə·lā·ḵîn
verses.literal: Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings

verses.original: אַ֤ל לַֽמְלָכִ֨ים׀ לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽמְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתוֹ־ יָ֑יִן וּ֝לְרוֹזְנִ֗ים אוֹ שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al lam·lā·ḵîm lə·mō·w·’êl ’al lam·lā·ḵîm šə·ṯōw- yā·yin ū·lə·rō·wz·nîm ʾō šê·ḵār
verses.literal: It is not for kings O Lemuel it is not for kings to drink wine or for rulers [to crave] strong drink

verses.original: פֶּן־ יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח מְחֻקָּ֑ק וִֽ֝ישַׁנֶּה כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃ דִּ֣ין
verses.transliteration: pen- yiš·teh wə·yiš·kaḥ mə·ḥuq·qāq wî·šan·neh kāl- bə·nê- ‘ō·nî dîn
verses.literal: lest they drink and forget what is decreed depriving all the oppressed . . . of justice

verses.original: תְּנוּ־ שֵׁכָ֣ר לְאוֹבֵ֑ד וְ֝יַיִן לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nū- šê·ḵār lə·’ō·w·ḇêḏ wə·ya·yin lə·mā·rê nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Give strong drink to one who is perishing and wine to the bitter in soul

verses.original: יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח רִישׁ֑וֹ יִזְכָּר־ וַ֝עֲמָל֗וֹ לֹ֣א עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·teh wə·yiš·kaḥ rî·šōw yiz·kār- wa·‘ă·mā·lōw lō ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Let him drink and forget his poverty and remember his misery no more

verses.original: פְּתַח־ פִּ֥יךָ לְאִלֵּ֑ם אֶל־ דִּ֝֗ין כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֽוֹף׃
verses.transliteration: pə·ṯaḥ- pî·ḵā lə·’il·lêm ’el- dîn kāl- bə·nê ḥă·lō·wp̄
verses.literal: Open your mouth for those with no voice for the cause of all the dispossessed . . .

verses.original: פְּתַח־ פִּ֥יךָ שְׁפָט־ צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝דִ֗ין עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·ṯaḥ- pî·ḵā šə·p̄āṭ- ṣe·ḏeq wə·ḏîn ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: Open your mouth judge righteously and defend the cause of the poor and needy

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־ חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְרָחֹ֖ק מִכְרָֽהּ׃ מִפְּנִינִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’ê·šeṯ- ḥa·yil mî yim·ṣā wə·rā·ḥōq miḵ·rāh mip·pə·nî·nîm
verses.literal: A wife of noble character who can find She is far more precious than rubies

verses.original: לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑הּ בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭הּ יֶחְסָֽר׃ לֹ֣א וְ֝שָׁלָ֗ל
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ba‘·lāh bā·ṭaḥ bāh yeḥ·sār lō wə·šā·lāl
verses.literal: The heart of her husband trusts in her and he lacks nothing of value

verses.original: גְּמָלַ֣תְהוּ ט֣וֹב וְלֹא־ רָ֑ע כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיה׃
verses.transliteration: gə·mā·laṯ·hū ṭō·wḇ wə·lō- rā‘ kōl yə·mê ḥay·yɛh
verses.literal: She brings him good and not harm all the days of her life

verses.original: דָּ֭רְשָׁה צֶ֣מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ֝תַּ֗עַשׂ בְּחֵ֣פֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·rə·šāh ṣe·mer ū·p̄iš·tîm wat·ta·‘aś bə·ḥê·p̄eṣ kap·pe·hā
verses.literal: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands

verses.original: הָ֭יְתָה סוֹחֵ֑ר כָּאֳנִיּ֣וֹת תָּבִ֥יא לַחְמָֽהּ׃ מִ֝מֶּרְחָ֗ק
verses.transliteration: hā·yə·ṯāh sō·w·ḥêr kā·’o·nî·yō·wṯ tā·ḇî laḥ·māh mim·mer·ḥāq
verses.literal: She is like the merchant ships bringing her food from afar

verses.original: וַתָּ֤קָם׀ בְּע֬וֹד לַ֗יְלָה וַתִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְבֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝חֹ֗ק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·qām bə·‘ō·wḏ lay·lāh wat·tit·tên ṭe·rep̄ lə·ḇê·ṯāh wə·ḥōq lə·na·‘ă·rō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: She rises while it is still night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidservants

verses.original: זָמְמָ֣ה שָׂ֭דֶה וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ מִפְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗יהָ נְטַע כָּֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: zā·mə·māh śā·d̲eh wat·tiq·qā·ḥê·hū mip·pə·rî ḵap·pe·hā nə·ṭaʿ kā·rem
verses.literal: She appraises a field and buys it from her earnings . . . she plants a vineyard

verses.original: חָֽגְרָ֣ה מָתְנֶ֑יהָ בְע֣וֹז זְרֹעוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וַ֝תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḡə·rāh mā·ṯə·ne·hā ḇə·‘ō·wz zə·rō·‘ō·w·ṯe·hā wat·tə·’am·mêṣ
verses.literal: She girds herself . . . with strength and shows that her arms are strong

verses.original: טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי־ סַחְרָ֑הּ ט֣וֹב נֵרָֽהּ׃ לֹֽא־ יִכְבֶּ֖ה בַלַּיִל
verses.transliteration: ṭā·‘ă·māh kî- saḥ·rāh ṭō·wḇ nê·rāh lō- yiḵ·beh ḇal·la·yil
verses.literal: She sees that her gain [is] good and her lamp is not extinguished at night

verses.original: שִׁלְּחָ֣ה יָ֭דֶיהָ בַכִּישׁ֑וֹר תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ׃ וְ֝כַפֶּ֗יהָ
verses.transliteration: šil·lə·ḥāh yā·ḏe·hā ḇak·kî·šō·wr tā·mə·ḵū p̄ā·leḵ wə·ḵap·pe·hā
verses.literal: She stretches out her hands to the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers

verses.original: פָּרְשָׂ֣ה כַּ֭פָּהּ לֶעָנִ֑י שִׁלְּחָ֥ה וְ֝יָדֶ֗יהָ לָֽאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: pā·rə·śāh kap·pāh le·‘ā·nî šil·lə·ḥāh wə·yā·ḏe·hā lā·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: She opens her arms to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy

verses.original: מִשָּׁ֑לֶג לֹא־ תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ כִּ֥י כָל־ בֵּ֝יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šā·leḡ lō- ṯî·rā lə·ḇê·ṯāh kî ḵāl bê·ṯāh lā·ḇuš šā·nîm
verses.literal: When it snows she has no fear for her household for [they are] all . . . clothed in scarlet

verses.original: עָֽשְׂתָה־ לָּ֑הּ מַרְבַדִּ֥ים לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְאַרְגָּמָ֣ן
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śə·ṯāh- lāh mar·ḇad·dîm lə·ḇū·šāh šêš wə·’ar·gā·mān
verses.literal: She makes coverings for her bed her clothing is fine linen and purple

verses.original: בַּעְלָ֑הּ נוֹדָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בְּ֝שִׁבְתּ֗וֹ עִם־ זִקְנֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ba‘·lāh nō·w·ḏā‘ baš·šə·‘ā·rîm bə·šiḇ·tōw ‘im- ziq·nê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Her husband is known at the city gates where he sits among the elders of the land

verses.original: עָ֭שְׂתָה סָדִ֣ין וַתִּמְכֹּ֑ר נָתְנָ֥ה וַ֝חֲג֗וֹר לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śə·ṯāh sā·ḏîn wat·tim·kōr nā·ṯə·nāh wa·ḥă·ḡō·wr lak·kə·na·‘ă·nî
verses.literal: She makes linen garments and sells [them] she delivers sashes to the merchants

verses.original: עֹז־ וְהָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑הּ וַ֝תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְי֣וֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ōz- wə·hā·ḏār lə·ḇū·šāh wat·tiś·ḥaq lə·yō·wm ’a·ḥă·rō·wn
verses.literal: Strength and honor are her clothing and she can laugh at the days to come

verses.original: פָּתְחָ֣ה פִּ֭יהָ בְחָכְמָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד וְתֽוֹרַת־ עַל־ לְשׁוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ṯə·ḥāh pî·hā ḇə·ḥā·ḵə·māh ḥe·seḏ wə·ṯō·w·raṯ- ‘al- lə·šō·w·nāh
verses.literal: She opens her mouth with wisdom and faithful instruction is on her tongue

verses.original: צ֭וֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכ֣וֹת בֵּיתָ֑הּ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל׃ וְלֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת
verses.transliteration: ṣō·w·p̄î·yāh hă·lî·ḵō·wṯ bê·ṯāh lō ṯō·ḵêl wə·le·ḥem ‘aṣ·lūṯ
verses.literal: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness

verses.original: בָ֭נֶיהָ קָ֣מוּ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֑וּהָ בַּ֝עְלָ֗הּ וַֽיְהַֽלְלָהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·ne·hā qā·mū way·’aš·šə·rū·hā ba‘·lāh way·ha·lə·lå̄h
verses.literal: Her children rise up and call her blessed her husband praises her as well

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת בָּ֭נוֹת עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל־ כֻּלָּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bō·wṯ bā·nō·wṯ ‘ā·śū ḥā·yil wə·’at ‘ā·lîṯ ‘al- kul·lā·nāh
verses.literal: Many daughters have done noble things but you surpass them all

verses.original: הַ֭חֵן שֶׁ֣קֶר הַיֹּ֑פִי וְהֶ֣בֶל אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥên še·qer hay·yō·p̄î wə·he·ḇel ’iš·šāh yir·’aṯ- Yah·weh hî ṯiṯ·hal·lāl
verses.literal: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting but a woman who fears the LORD - is to be praised

verses.original: תְּנוּ־ לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ׃ וִֽיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: tə·nū- lāh mip·pə·rî yā·ḏe·hā ma·‘ă·śe·hā wî·hal·lū·hā ḇaš·šə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Give her the fruit of her hands and let her works praise her at the gates
